<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—multiple peaks spaced by ~1 Da with intensities decreasing roughly 100 : 9 : 0.6 : 0.03 : …—the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing several carbon atoms. No other common element shows such a multi‑peak, 1 Da spaced pattern with these relative intensities. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
